arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT "config" AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT "pending_booking", b.booking_id, json_object("request",b.request_id,"flight",b.flight_id,"passenger",b.passenger_id,"amount",b.amount_cents,"reference",b.client_reference,"charges",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("id",c.charge_id,"key",c.idempotency_key,"amount",c.amount_cents,"state",c.state,"step",c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),"hold",(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),"cancel",(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status="pending" UNION ALL SELECT "outbox",event_id,json_object("booking",booking_id,"payload",payload,"attempts",attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status="pending" UNION ALL SELECT "flight",flight_id,json_object("capacity",capacity,"price",price_cents,"version",version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT "cache",key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT "cancel",event_id,json_object("request",request_id,"step",step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'config' AS kind, service AS id, value AS data FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_booking', b.booking_id, json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',flight_id,json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',key,value FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events

SELECT 'related_booking' AS kind,b.booking_id AS id,json_object('request',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' OR b.client_reference IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',hold_id,json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'failure_log',CAST(id AS TEXT),json_object('service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE status>=400 ORDER BY kind,id LIMIT 100

SELECT b.*,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.created_step, (SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id) AS cancellations FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id WHERE b.status='pending' OR b.client_reference IN (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL)
